name: Two Adventurers One Bed
source:
After a long day of travel, Rayla and Callum find themselves in a cozy inn. Being the people that they are, they don't hesitate to take a room with two beds.

...Only for one of the beds to be badly broken.

Though Callum tried sleeping on the broken bed, the continuous falling-of-the-edge-of-the-bed turns out to be rather problematic for both Callum and Rayla. How will these two solve the issue?
